column8:
MRP

“MRP” stands for “Maximum Retail Price”. It's the highest price that a seller is allowed to sell a product for including taxes, charges added on the basic price of the product. No seller can sell a product for a price higher than MRP. Acceptable in INR ONLY. This information is generally available on the packaging label for pre-packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please provide the MRP as per the explanation above.

column11:
Net Weight (gms)

Means the total weight of the product excluding the packaging weight, in grams (g). This information is available on the packaging label for pre-packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please check the weight of the product excluding any external packing and provide such information in SI Unit - grams.
column12:
Inventory

Number of items you have in stock.
column13:
Country of Origin

Country of Origin means the country in which the product has been produced/assembled. This information is available on the packaging label for pre- packed products. If you are not listing a pre-packed product, please provide the country in which the product is manufactured.
column14:
Manufacturer Name

Enter the name of the Manufacturer which means the entity which has produced the product. This information is available on the packaging label of the product. Find “manufactured by” on the label. Manufacturer name may look like: ABC Appliances Pvt. Ltd.  If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for producing your product.
column15:
Manufacturer Address

Enter the complete address of the Manufacturer which means the entity which has produced the product. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “manufactured by” on the label. In the address, please specify the street, village/ town/ district along with the name of the state. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for producing your product.
column16:
Manufacturer Pincode

Enter the pincode mentioned in the manufacturers’ address.
column17:
Packer Name

Enter the name of the Packer which generally means the entity which has packed the product. Packer details can generally be found on the label of the product. Find “Packed by” or “Pkd” on the label. Manufacturer name may look like: ABC Appliances Pvt. Ltd. In case your product does not have this information, provide the details of the packer of your product. In many cases, the manufacturer and packer may be the same.
column18:
Packer Address

Enter the address of the Packer which generally means the entity which has packed the product. Packer details can generally be found on the label of the product. Find “Packed by” or “Pkd” on the label. In case your product does not have this information, provide the details of the packer of your product. In many cases, the manufacturer and packer may be the same.
column19:
Packer Pincode

Enter the pincode mentioned in the packers’ address.
column20:
Importer Name

Enter the name of the Importer which means the entity which has imported the product from any other country into India for sale in India. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “imported by” on the label. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for importing your product.
column21:
Importer Address

Enter the address of the Importer which means the entity which has imported the product from any other country into India for sale in India. This information is generally available on the packaging label of the product. Find “imported by” on the label. If this information is not available on the label of your product or your product does not have a label, provide the details of the entity/person who is responsible for importing your product.
column22:

Enter the pincode mentioned in the importers’ address.
column26:
Generic Name

Generic Name means the commonly used name through which a product is generally called/known. Generic name DOES NOT MEAN the name of the brand or manufacturer of the product or its use.
column27:
Net Quantity (N)

Net Quantity means total number of units in the product. If the product is a multi- pack, please mention the total number of units in the multi-pack. 

For example- if you are selling t-shirts in a multi-pack of 4, please specify 4.

Product ID / Style ID

Style Code is an alphanumeric code which is given to a product and can be found on the tag or packaging. Style Code remains the same for all Size variants and changes for all Color variants. For example, a red colored product that comes in three different sizes will have the same Style Code.
column39:
